title: Evolith Rule Definition Schema
description: Schema for individual rule definitions within Evolith rulesets.

opa_policy.description: Package path of the corresponding OPA policy

validation.description: GT-647 — how this rule is checked. A rule in this shape is NOT evaluated by the Core rule engine (which reads the `rules[]`/`principles[]` corpus shape); it is enforced by the paired CI guard and Rego policy named here. The two authored instances (INFRA-001, INFRA-OPA-001) carried this block from the start and the schema never modelled it, so they failed their own contract and were reported as broken rulesets on every evaluation.

type.description: Check performed by the enforcing guard, e.g. `file_pattern_ban`, `helm_opa_bundle_integrity`.

target.description: Repo-relative paths or globs the guard inspects.

exclude.description: Paths or globs carved out of `target`.

guard.description: Repo-relative path of the CI script that actually enforces this rule.

opa_equivalent.description: Repo-relative path of the Rego policy expressing the same rule.
